articles.summary: WEST DES MOINES, Iowa, Oct. 23, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - West Bancorporation, Inc. (Nasdaq: WTBA; the “Company”), parent company of West Bank, today reported third quarter 2025 net income of $9.3 million, or $0.55 per diluted common share, compared to second quarter 2025 net income of $8.0 million, or $0.47 per diluted common share, and third quarter 2024 net income of $6.0 million, or $0.35 per diluted common share. articles.title: West Bancorporation, Inc. Announces Third Quarter 2025 Financial Results and Declares Quarterly Dividend
